title: Natural short exact Hom sequences for a stupid source tail with independent site universes
statement: Let C be a small category, J a Grothendieck topology and R a sheaf of commutative rings. Let P be a cochain complex of sheaves of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and k an integer with P^n zero for n<k. Let G have P^k in degree k and zero elsewhere, with zero differentials, and let U be the stupid tail: P in degrees at least k+1, zero below, and the inherited differentials. For every chain map f:M to N, the three induced Hom maps Hom(G,f), Hom(P,f), Hom(U,f) [def-pur-hom-complex] are, up to isomorphisms of arrows, the three components of a morphism between two short exact sequences of cochain complexes. No boundedness or quasi-isomorphism assumption is imposed on P, M, N or f. Here the site has object universe c and morphism universe v, the commutative coefficient ring and module sheaves have universe max c v r, and the sheafification hypotheses are explicit. No equality of these universes is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0A8X, Hom products and differential; step 2 of lem-pc-bounded-exact-term-hom-quasi-iso; degreewise split sequence entering Tag 0117

proof.text: Construct the source short complex U → P → G using HomologicalComplex.ιStupidTrunc and mkHomToSingle. The latter is a chain map because each differential into degree k has zero source by hbelow. The composite is zero by to_single_hom_ext and the zero degree-k term of U. Its evaluation in each degree has a splitting: at k the projection is an isomorphism and U is zero; above k the inclusion is an isomorphism and G is zero; below k both U and P are zero. Use ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIsZeroOfIsIso and ofIsIsoOfIsZero.

Prove homComplex_preservesZero from the product projections and their componentwise map formula: internal Hom precomposition by zero vanishes sectionwise. For any degreewise split source short complex, build a retraction and section in each Hom degree by the limit-fan lifts whose components precompose with the source splitting section and retraction. Fan hom-ext, homObjMap composition, and sectionwise additivity verify the three splitting identities. Splitting.shortExact and HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact give exactness as complexes. This is the proved private helper homComplex_degreewise_split; it needs no exactness of infinite products.

Map the opposite source short complex by homComplexFunctor.flip.obj M and by its value at N. Apply the degreewise-splitting helper to both. The natural transformation homComplexFunctor.flip.map f induces their morphism by ShortComplex.mapNatTrans. Its components are definitionally the three specified Hom maps; Iso.refl supplies each arrow isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_homComplex_stupid_tail_shortExactOfUniverses
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (k : ℤ) (hbelow : ∀ n : ℤ, n < k → IsZero (P.X n))
    {M N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ}
    (f : M ⟶ N) : ∃ S T : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ),
      ∃ φ : S ⟶ T, S.ShortExact ∧ T.ShortExact ∧
        Nonempty (Arrow.mk φ.τ₁ ≅ Arrow.mk (((homComplexFunctor.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R :=
            R)).obj
          (op ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k).obj
            (P.X k)))).map f)) ∧
        Nonempty (Arrow.mk φ.τ₂ ≅ Arrow.mk
          (((homComplexFunctor.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R)).obj (op P)).map f)) ∧
        Nonempty (Arrow.mk φ.τ₃ ≅ Arrow.mk (((homComplexFunctor.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R :=
            R)).obj
          (op (P.stupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE (k + 1))))).map f))
